summary: Recorded the correction the diagnostic receipt forces. That makes two statements from my earlier accounts wrong as written — that the scenario does not exercise a completed re-synchronisation, and the matching limitation — so I corrected the knowledge entry's conditions (revision 5, adding the diagnostic receipt) and rewrote the interpretation's rationale, counterevidence and limitations around the corrected reading: the re-synchronisation is exercised and carries no decided progress, the caller-visible violation stands (reproduced three times at 1000 ms plus the smaller-period controls), and what remains unobserved is narrower — where exactly the stale placeholders come from in a construction whose origin decided index never advances. The question's discriminator now names the single open item: why the new leader never decides its own entry here, which a construction that lets it reach a write quorum would exercise.
